experience.company.note: Role 2's employer line is drawn “Ohio Valley State University — IT Service Desk — Columbus, Ohio”; `company` comes back as just “Ohio Valley State University”. The sub-org is not lost — the parser puts it on `team` and peels the location onto `location` — but `experience.company` scores the `company` field alone, so the org–suborg half is invisible to this measurement. Recorded so company recall is comparable with google-docs/google-docs-skia-proxy-role-first-experience, whose employer line has the identical org–suborg shape and whose truth already records the full drawn line. Possibly a defensible org/team split rather than a defect — recorded rather than assumed, because ground truth's job is to state what the page says and let a human adjudicate. The trailing location is deliberately EXCLUDED from the truth value, matching how this file's `education.institution` truth excludes the same em-dash location suffix.
